description: Fresh Pari-authored English Core shadow seed. Evaluation-only. Designed to mirror research-backed linguistic phenomena without copying public benchmark items.
validationGate: Do not treat these labels as an independently validated public benchmark until multiple independent proficient/native English annotators review them and ambiguous items are adjudicated. See GitHub issue #16.

policy.rotation: add/rotate cases when models are repeatedly optimized against this file
policy.reporting: report shadow results separately from public-anchor benchmarks
policy.claimLimit: internal contamination-resistant diagnostic until independent annotation is complete
